meta.title: MTQARAN — Academy & Armenian Villages Development Fund
meta.description: MTQARAN brings together two directions: MTQARAN Academy and the Armenian Villages Development Fund "We Are Our Villages".

home.hero_title: Knowledge and roots. One goal — a stronger Armenia.
home.hero_subtitle: MTQARAN unites two directions: educating a new generation and reviving Armenian villages.
home.academy_card_text: Lectures, mentors and practical courses for those who want to grow and share knowledge.
home.fund_card_text: We build workout grounds and support initiatives in Armenian villages — region by region.

academy.hero_subtitle: Lectures and mentors sharing hands-on experience — from entrepreneurship to crafts.

academy.learning_paths_text: Courses are grouped into themed tracks, so you can go from fundamentals to practice.
academy.community_text: An idea for the future: the best graduate projects from the Academy could be deployed directly in villages from the Development Fund — turning knowledge into real change.
